tools.name: generate_textures
tools.description: Start a background texture job and return its job_id at once. backend is z-image-turbo, flux2-klein-4b, or both. Poll get_texture_job(job_id) for progress and the PNG paths.

tools.name: get_texture_job
tools.description: Return a texture job's state: queued, running (completed/total), succeeded (with PNG paths and timings), or failed (with code, message, and remediation).

tools.name: texture_backends
tools.description: Report each texture backend as available, not_installed, unsupported_platform, or insufficient_memory.
